svg.title: Six simulated signals and their reconstructed trajectory
svg.desc: Six weighted observations of sixteen heterogeneous coupled Kuramoto phase oscillators appear above a fixed three-dimensional PCA projection of their multivariate delay coordinates. The traces show 7.5 seconds and the trajectory shows 13 seconds. The same latest 0.8 seconds are highlighted in both views. These are model-generated signals, not experimental recordings. No stimulation has been applied in this still. Generated reproducibly with seed 20261113.
